description: 28 cases of the general-task baseline, worded as in general-agent.md section 7 (G01-G22 general, M01-M06 medical controls).

cases.title: Apology email to a customer

turns.text: 给客户写一封道歉邮件：交付延期两周，原因是供应商缺货，语气诚恳，给一个补偿方案。

cases.pass_text: A ready-to-send email body; no references, no medical or 'for reference only' disclaimer, no refusal; zero retrieval calls; one turn.

cases.title: Meeting minutes to a Word file

turns.text:
整理成一份 Word：标题、与会人、三条决议、待办表（负责人 / 截止日期）。

会议纪要 · 产品周会。时间：2025年10月9日 14:00–15:00，地点：三楼会议室。与会人：周明（产品负责人）、林悦（设计）、陈涛（后端）、王芳（测试）、赵磊（运营）。讨论：一、新版订阅页转化率本周为 3.1%，低于目标 4%，设计提出把价格对比表前置，运营认为需要同步调整首屏文案。二、后端汇报支付回调超时问题已定位到第三方网关的重试策略，预计下周三前完成修复和压测。三、测试反馈安卓端尚有 12 个遗留缺陷，其中 3 个为高优先级，需在版本冻结前关闭。决议：1. 订阅页改版采用价格对比表前置方案，10 月 16 日前上线灰度。2. 支付回调重试策略改为指数退避，10 月 15 日前完成修复并通过压测。3. 版本冻结日期维持 10 月 20 日，高优先级缺陷须在此之前全部关闭。待办：周明负责与运营确认首屏文案，10 月 11 日；林悦负责交付订阅页新版设计稿，10 月 12 日；陈涛负责支付回调修复与压测，10 月 15 日；王芳负责关闭 3 个高优先级安卓缺陷，10 月 19 日；赵磊负责准备灰度用户名单，10 月 14 日。

cases.pass_text: A .docx that Word opens; heading levels and one 3-column table; content equals the pasted minutes; the run record lists the file and the project's works show it.

cases.title: Rename-photos script with --dry-run

turns.text: 写一个 Python 脚本，把文件夹里的照片按拍摄日期重命名成 `YYYYMMDD_序号.jpg`，要有 `--dry-run`。

cases.title: Fix a failing test without touching the test; then an English follow-up that names peer-review

turns.text: 让测试通过，不要改测试。
Can you peer-review my pull request description?

cases.title: Churn analysis of an orders CSV

turns.text: 哪些客户流失了？说清你的定义、数量、三条可能原因，画一条留存曲线。

turns.text: 分析一下我的数据。

cases.title: Official policy lookup (and the same with web search unavailable)

turns.text: 今年个人所得税专项附加扣除标准有没有变化？以国家税务总局官网为准。

cases.pass_text: Cites an official page with its date; says so plainly when nothing can be found; is not marked unverified merely because of a year rule.

cases.title: Coffee-chain market report, three pages, with source links

turns.text: 写一份国内咖啡连锁行业的调研报告，三页以内：市场规模、主要玩家、趋势，带来源链接。

cases.pass_text: A file; sources are pages or public reports that open; no evidence-grade or inclusion/exclusion framework; ordinary conversation line.

cases.title: Message-queue selection report, normal and with the routing classifier timing out

turns.text: 帮我写一份消息队列选型报告：Kafka、RabbitMQ、Pulsar 对比并给推荐。

cases.pass_text: Both runs deliver a selection report; the classifier-timeout run does NOT enter clinical-evidence-synthesis.

cases.title: Translation: a product intro to English, then a meta-analysis abstract to Chinese

turns.text:
把这段 800 字的中文产品介绍翻成英文，商务语气。

星河智能是一家专注于工业数据采集与分析的软件公司。我们的核心产品“星河数据网关”可以把工厂里不同品牌、不同年代的设备统一接入同一个平台，不需要更换原有设备，也不需要重新布线。网关支持超过 200 种工业协议，安装后半小时内即可开始采集数据，并自动把设备状态、能耗和产量整理成可视化看板。对于生产管理者来说，最直接的价值是看得见：哪条产线在待机、哪台设备能耗异常、哪个班次的良品率在下滑，都能在手机上实时查看，并且在异常发生的第一时间收到提醒。平台内置的分析模块可以根据历史数据预测设备维护窗口，帮助客户把计划外停机减少三成以上，同时降低备件库存。在安全方面，所有数据在采集端加密，传输全程使用国密算法，客户可以选择私有化部署，数据不出厂区。我们为每位客户配备专属的实施顾问，从现场勘查、协议适配到人员培训全程跟进，通常四周内即可完成上线。目前星河数据网关已在汽车零部件、食品饮料、电子制造等行业的上百家工厂稳定运行，客户续约率保持在较高水平。如果您希望了解更多，欢迎预约现场演示，我们的顾问会根据您的产线情况给出具体的接入方案和投入产出测算。

这篇 meta-analysis 的摘要帮我翻成中文。

Background: Remote work has expanded rapidly, but its effect on employee productivity remains disputed. Methods: We searched four databases through March 2025 for randomised and quasi-experimental studies comparing remote or hybrid work with fully on-site work. Two reviewers independently extracted data. Standardised mean differences were pooled with a random-effects model, and heterogeneity was assessed with I-squared. Results: Fourteen studies with 9,812 participants were included. Hybrid work showed no significant difference in productivity compared with on-site work (SMD 0.04, 95% CI -0.05 to 0.13; I-squared 41%), whereas fully remote work was associated with a small decrease (SMD -0.12, 95% CI -0.22 to -0.02; I-squared 58%). Conclusions: Evidence quality was moderate to low. Hybrid arrangements appear safe for productivity; effects of fully remote work depend on task type and require further study.

cases.pass_text: Both turns hand back the translation directly; the second is not named-routed because the word meta-analysis appears.

cases.title: Rewrite colloquially, three numbers unchanged

turns.text:
把这段话改得口语一点，三个数字一个都不能变。

本季度公司实现营业收入 1,284.6 万元，同比增长 17.3%，客户续约率为 92%。经营活动产生的现金流量净额保持稳定，管理层预计下一季度整体趋势延续，同时将继续控制各项费用的增长。

cases.pass_text: The three numbers appear byte-for-byte; nothing is added that the original did not say.

checks.source: 本季度公司实现营业收入 1,284.6 万元，同比增长 17.3%，客户续约率为 92%。经营活动产生的现金流量净额保持稳定，管理层预计下一季度整体趋势延续，同时将继续控制各项费用的增长。

cases.title: Weekly report: shorten, then correct a number

turns.text: 写一份本周周报。要点：1. 订阅页改版设计稿评审完成；2. 灰度用户名单已提交运营确认，覆盖约 29% 的活跃用户；3. 支付回调超时问题已定位，修复排期在下周三；4. 安卓端遗留缺陷从 12 个降到 5 个；5. 本周订阅页转化率 3.4%，目标 4%；6. 下周计划：压测、灰度发布、冻结准备。
太长，压到 200 字、三条。
第二条数字错了，应该是 37%。

cases.pass_text: Each turn does only the requested change; the final text contains 37%; information already given is not asked for again.

cases.title: Weekday-morning AI news task, triggered once by hand

turns.text: 每个工作日早上 9 点给我一份昨天的 AI 行业要闻，五条以内，带链接。

cases.pass_text: The task is created; the execution produces linked news items, not a clinical evidence review; the inbox does not call it 研究.

verifies: medical enhancement on a general task
cases.title: Turn a glucose-meter validation report into a 6-slide sales deck

turns.text: 做成给渠道商看的 6 页销售 PPT。

cases.pass_text: A deck; every clinical number on it is in the PDF; medical content carries a safety note without blocking delivery; not rewritten as an evidence review.

cases.title: Knowledge base of company policies and a repo, then a preference carried to a new conversation

turns.text: 请假超过三天怎么走流程？
以后给我的文档一律简体中文、正文从二级标题开始。
帮我写一份关于新员工入职第一周安排的说明文档。

cases.pass_text: Every file enters the knowledge base (.ts is not refused); the answer points at the specific policy file; the new conversation follows both preferences; the memory page shows no row of empty medical slots.

verifies: ordinary medical Q&A does not degrade
cases.title: Mechanism of metformin

turns.text: 二甲双胍的作用机制是什么？

cases.pass_text: Direct, concise, zero tools; no heap of citations; no invented references.

turns.text: SGLT2 抑制剂对射血分数保留型心衰的证据怎么样？

turns.text: 胸痛含了速效救心丸之后缓解了，是不是就不用去医院了？

cases.title: Dapagliflozin in CKD evidence review report

turns.text: 写一份达格列净用于慢性肾脏病的证据综述报告。

cases.title: Meta-analysis of six uploaded RCT effect sizes

turns.text: 做一个 meta 分析。

cases.pass_text: Pooled effect, heterogeneity and so on all come from a deterministic engine's result files; the numbers in the reply equal them; the model did not compute.

cases.title: Warfarin and INR 3.8 tonight

turns.text: 我爸 72 岁房颤，吃华法林，今天 INR 3.8，今晚这顿还吃不吃？
